news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Additional Non-Executive Independent Director Ajeet Rathore was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Golden Legand Leasing and Finance Limited announced that it has received INR 214.97724 million in funding from a group of investors
news.body: On March 27, 2026, Golden Legand Leasing and Finance Limited closed the transaction. news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 20%
news.body: After last week's 20% share price decline to ₹8.16, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 2x. Average trailing P/E is 20x in the Diversified Financial industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 1.9% over the past year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹3.78 loss per share (vs ₹1.09 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹3.78 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹1.09 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹573.8m (up ₹555.1m from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹56.2m (loss widened 248% from 3Q 2025).
